title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: six-class (negation + GLV) parallel Pollard rho in G1, global work meter, truncated-product canonicalisation

claims.statement: For a uniform challenge T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1 (T=infinity returns 0), the algorithm in proof.md outputs x with success probability at least 0.39, and on every run its total work is at most 2^126.2044 batched-affine-G1-addition equivalents (C=2,000 instructions), enforced by a global work meter that charges every action at an upper-bound price before execution and halts with failure at 2^126.2044. The algorithm is parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho (2^22 walks, distinguished probability 2^-64, trail cap 20*2^64) on the (r-1)/6 classes of G1 under negation and phi=[lambda], lambda=0xac45a4010001a40200000000ffffffff; class key K = the even one of y and p-y (bit 0 identically 0; twist sign is bit 0 of y); canonical twist index from a truncated 12-multiply fixed-point product (exact fallback on near-ties, separately metered; section 1.1); R=2^21 twisted table so each step is one batched affine addition plus at most 96.0561 instructions (96 AArch64-listed, entry address carried in x5 from row 5 to row 6, cap test folded into the every-64th refresh since L_max is a multiple of 64, plus a share below 0.0561 of the per-batch inversion work, charged without allowance; the refresh is a separately metered 0.0055-unit action ending with the shared cap test); cycles of F of length <=64 detected by a period-64 checkpoint alone and escaped by doubling the cycle's minimum class under one fixed total order (192-bit fingerprints, limbs 0-2 of K; a class map; no cancellation through doublings since ord(2 mod r)=2^250.86), so trails meeting a common class reunite; collisions solved by re-walking with coefficients mod r and x=(e_2-e_1)/(f_1-f_2) verified before output. Phase 1 stops when a hard operation counter reaches S_ops=1.005*S0 (S0=sqrt(2N'ln(1/0.6097)), steps 1.04802805, traversals 1.06152805, doublings 1.50052805, (1.04802805+0.0055/64)*(S_ops+2^44)<2^126.20350 with overshoot below 2^44, N'=((r-1)/6)*R/(R-1)); phase 2 completes open trails; report capacity 2^63.25 and 8 processed matches are caps counted as failure. Peak memory below 2^72 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^57.2 units, enforced by a meter sub-cap and included in the total; no advice. Heuristic H1: within S_ops class arrivals of all trails the first inter-trail collision has occurred with probability at least 1-exp(-(S_ops/1.005)^2/(2N'))=0.3903 (random-mapping law with 0.5% slowdown allowance; toy extrapolation +0.24% +- 0.18%); the meter's early-halt probability is below 0.000059 (below 0.00018 if cycle rates triple; Markov), the partition/distinguished bits of K are pseudo-random, and apart from detected fruitless cycles a trail returns to a past class at most with the random-mapping rate L_max^2/(2N) per trail; the canonical twist of a new class is uniform and independent of its partition index, and beta*x mod p is equidistributed (these affect only the meter's early-halt probability); supported by toy-curve experiments; no production-size run.

experiments.purpose: Part A: on BLS12-381 G1, check the GLV pair, orbit size 6 and unit action, the parity class key (one key per class, bit 0 zero, bijection with |y|), canonical member, the section-5 row-4/row-5 limb rule (limbs 0-2, borrow chain, h, distinguished test, table address 8h+4s+j) against the exact K mod 2^192 on random, boundary and distinguished-key y, the section-1.1 truncated-product canonical index against the exact rule (random and adversarial near-tie inputs), the merged fallback branch of rows 2-3 at flag level against the OR of the three section-1.1 tests, twisted-step and doubling class maps, the order of 2 mod r, table entries, coefficient tracking, and recovery of a planted x from two merged production trails. Part B: run the section-2 algorithm on a toy curve y^2=x^3+4 over F_q and report class visits to the first inter-trail collision against the random-mapping model; pipeline=true applies the scaled production rules (phase-1 budget, phase 2, report capacity, 8-match cap) and reports success. Toy scale only; canon_random/canon_stress set section-1.1 check counts; toy=false skips Part B. The cost block prints section 5's ledger and the claim's success bounds, with exact-fraction checks.
